development_attempts_retained.reason: Headless Chromium required --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream in addition to fake device/permission. Test harness configuration fixed; first screenshots also lacked system CJK fonts.
Harness queried innerText inside a collapsed details element and received empty text. Fixed to textContent; runtime counter was correct.
Playwright evaluate auto-invoked the returned permission-denial function. Wrapped the test setter in a block.
14 classes passed; release run adds explicit 1366x768 control visibility check.
Chrome looped the short input WAV, never leaving sufficient EoU hold. Harness now adds leading/trailing silence and uses %noloop; production code unchanged.

First full-worktree pytest during concurrent cleanup: 190 passed, 1 historical test_w1_golden_traces failed (9/20 equivalence versus 90% threshold). Demo work did not edit or remove that test; a later separate cleanup removed it. Final observed worktree collection was 188 passing tests.

limitations: No real laptop microphone/headphone/speaker or external echo listening test.
No real laptop SSH endpoint was available; standard OpenSSH forwarding instructions are provided, and same-origin browser/server paths were tested locally.
No public authentication, quotas, tenant isolation or server-side data deletion feature. Use SSH forwarding for controlled presentation.
HumDial prompts and 15-character request remain unchanged. Transcript/generated text is not a word-aligned heard-prefix record.
Heavy browser test dependencies and Chinese fonts were installed only in an isolated temporary test environment; laptop users need only a browser and SSH client.
